news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹14.58 (up from ₹7.77 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹67.9b (up 37% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹6.70b (up 90% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 9.9% (up from 7.1% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.2%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 2.2%. Revenue is forecast to grow 22% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Insurance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 110% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 40% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
